description: What the front end is allowed to ask the core to do. Without this file the webview has no permissions at all and every IPC call is denied, which is how task 1.9's first probe came to report three failures it never actually tested. Both windows are listed: a capability names the windows it applies to, and a window left out of that list gets no core permission at all -- which is how the settings window's 關閉 button came to do nothing (1.14). Commands this app defines itself are not gated by this file; only the `core:` ones are.
